controls.label.print_viewing_glare_perce: Print viewing glare: percent, roughness, blur

controls.component.name: %{label} %{component}
controls.help.diffusion.family: PSF family. pro_mist / glimmerglass / cinebloom are transparent (energy-preserving); black_pro_mist absorbs a fraction of the deflected light, lifting shadows by reducing local contrast.
controls.help.diffusion.strength: Commercial filter stop: 0, 1/8=0.125, 1/4=0.25, 1/2=0.5, 1, 2. Maps internally to the (p_s, p_a) deflected/absorbed photon fractions.
controls.help.diffusion.scale: Multiplier on the image-plane PSF widths (all per-group lambdas). Adjust for image-format / print-size differences.
controls.help.diffusion.warmth: Additive offset on the family's halo warmth axis. Positive = warm outer halo / cool inner halo. Energy-preserving per channel. 0 = use family default.
controls.help.shares.help: Edit the first three shares; the fourth is the remaining share so the authored total stays one. All four shares must be positive.
controls.help.shares.transfer: Authored share; transfers weight to or from sublayer 4.
controls.help.illuminant.custom_help: Enter any shared catalog illuminant or BB<kelvin> (1667..=25000).
controls.help.channels.permutation: Permutation of film density channels. Selecting a channel swaps its prior position so no record is duplicated or dropped.
controls.help.glare.enable: Add readout stray light after lens blur and before scanner correction. This does not change print exposure or developed density.
controls.help.glare.blur: Sigma of gaussian blur in pixels for the glare
controls.help.diffusion.core_intensity: Advanced. Multiplier on the core weight; the three group weights are renormalized to sum to 1. 1.0 = use family default.
controls.help.diffusion.core_size: Advanced. Multiplier on the core lambda. 1.0 = use family default.
controls.help.diffusion.halo_intensity: Advanced. Multiplier on the halo weight; the three group weights are renormalized to sum to 1. 1.0 = use family default.
controls.help.diffusion.halo_size: Advanced. Multiplier on the halo lambda. 1.0 = use family default.
controls.help.diffusion.bloom_intensity: Advanced. Multiplier on the bloom weight; the three group weights are renormalized to sum to 1. 1.0 = use family default.
controls.help.diffusion.bloom_size: Advanced. Multiplier on the bloom lambda. 1.0 = use family default.
controls.condition.scan_operator: standard negative_to_positive on an eligible negative film scan route
controls.condition.dye: film_render.grain.engine = dye; supported stock, format and route
controls.condition.custom: film_render.grain.v2_profile = custom; select custom to use this control
controls.condition.sublayers: film_render.grain.sublayers_active = true; film profile supplies sublayer density curves
controls.condition.spektra_sublayers: when engine = spektra: film_render.grain.sublayers_active = true; film profile supplies sublayer density curves
controls.condition.camera_diffusion: camera.diffusion_filter.active = true; strength and spatial_scale positive
controls.condition.enlarger_diffusion: enlarger.diffusion_filter.active = true; strength and spatial_scale positive; io.scan_film = false
controls.condition.glare: io.scan_film = false; print_render.glare.active = true; percent > 0; stochastic effects enabled
controls.condition.film_development: actual Film development route; captured negatives and the input route are not redeveloped
controls.condition.print_development: admitted print-development route, including recovered-negative printing
controls.condition.preflash: enlarger.preflash_exposure > 0; zero disables flash and retains filter settings
controls.condition.film_chemistry: film_render.chemistry.active = true; supported fitted density_curves_model required
controls.condition.capture_illuminant: film-exposure route that converts scene RGB to film exposure
controls.condition.print_chemistry: print_render.density_curves_morph.active = true; supported fitted density_curves_model required
controls.condition.missing_model: selected material has no supported fitted density_curves_model; chemistry values remain stored and inactive
controls.condition.operator_route: negative film; eligible negative-to-positive route; standard conversion style
controls.condition.operator_retained: stored corrections retained while inactive; clipboard and comparison are session-only
controls.condition.halation_scope: core Halation feature-profile scope; inactive values retained
controls.condition.raw_custom: RAW source; custom white balance; explicit Reprocess RAW
controls.condition.transfer: TIFF editable; JPEG/PNG encoded, EXR linear
controls.description.remainder: 1 − sum of the first three shares
controls.chemistry.film_density_curve_ga: Gamma applied to the film density curves during development; 1.0 keeps the profile curves unchanged. Requires an actual film-development route.
controls.chemistry.print_density_curve_g: Gamma applied to the paper density curves during print development; 1.0 keeps the profile curves unchanged. Requires an admitted print-development route.
controls.chemistry.film_gamma_factor_hel: Global coupled gamma multiplier for the film density curves.
controls.chemistry.print_gamma_factor_he: Global coupled gamma multiplier for the print density curves.
controls.chemistry.gamma_factor_fast_hel: Gamma factor applied to the fast sub-layer.
controls.chemistry.gamma_factor_slow_hel: Gamma factor applied to the mid and slow sub-layers.
controls.chemistry.gamma_factor_red_help: Per-channel gamma factor applied to the red channel.
controls.chemistry.gamma_factor_green_he: Per-channel gamma factor applied to the green channel.
controls.chemistry.gamma_factor_blue_hel: Per-channel gamma factor applied to the blue channel.
controls.chemistry.film_developer_exhaus: Blend all three film sub-layers toward the matched Gumbel shoulder while preserving midgray via a common horizontal offset.
controls.chemistry.print_developer_exhau: Blend all three print sub-layers toward the matched Gumbel shoulder while preserving midgray via a common horizontal offset.
controls.couplers.key_controls: Key controls: inhibition samelayer (contrast) · inhibition interlayer (saturation) · inhibition amount (global)
controls.couplers.inhibition_amount_help: Global multiplier on the DIR coupler inhibition matrix. 1.0 leaves the per-channel gammas as-is.
controls.couplers.inhibition_samelayer_h: Multiplier on the same-layer (diagonal) inhibition. Controls overall contrast / gamma reduction within each RGB layer.
controls.couplers.inhibition_interlayer_: Multiplier on the cross-layer (off-diagonal) inhibition. Controls saturation enhancement from interlayer DIR effects.
controls.couplers.gamma_samelayer_help: Per-channel same-layer DIR gamma (R, G, B). Effective gamma reduction of each layer's density curve.
controls.couplers.gamma_red_to_green_blu: DIR inhibition from the R layer onto the G and B layers respectively (g_R->G, g_R->B).
controls.couplers.gamma_green_to_red_blu: DIR inhibition from the G layer onto the R and B layers respectively (g_G->R, g_G->B).
controls.couplers.gamma_blue_to_red_gree: DIR inhibition from the B layer onto the R and G layers respectively (g_B->R, g_B->G).
controls.couplers.langmuir_donor_help: NEGATIVE film: per-channel Langmuir saturation of DIR inhibitor release, normalized to each layer's d_max (R, G, B). Lower = earlier, stronger roll-off at high density (gentler shoulder, tames high-amount breakage); large values approach the linear model.
controls.couplers.langmuir_receiver_help: POSITIVE/reversal film: per-channel receiver-side Langmuir saturation (R, G, B), normalized to the arrived-inhibitor ceiling (the receiver analogue of langmuir_donor_k_rgb's d_max normalization). The donor (silver release) stays linear; this rolls off the receiving layer's response under a pushed amount. Lower = harder, more crash-proof knee (alters the operating-point look); large values approach linear.
controls.couplers.diffusion_size_help: Sigma in um for the diffusion of the couplers, (5-20 um), controls sharpness and affects saturation.
controls.couplers.diffusion_tail_help: Exponential tail scale in um for long-range coupler spread. Larger values extend the rare long-distance inhibition halo beyond the Gaussian core.
controls.couplers.diffusion_tail_weight_: Fraction of coupler diffusion energy assigned to the long tail. 0 = pure Gaussian spread, higher values add a longer-range inhibition shoulder.
controls.halation.key_controls: Key controls: halation amount (strength) · halation spatial scale (size) · scatter amount (highlight glow)
controls.halation.inactive_profile: Halation is inactive; stored profile values retained and available when enabled.
controls.halation.profile_help: Built-in feature profile; selecting it changes only Halation profile leaves.
controls.halation.profile_apply_error: Could not apply the Halation profile: %{error}
controls.halation.scatter_amount_help: High-level scatter strength. 1.0 = full physical scatter, 0.0 = no scatter. Scales the fraction of light that undergoes in-emulsion scattering.
controls.halation.scatter_spatial_scale_: High-level scatter size multiplier (1.0 = physical defaults). Scales both core and tail sigmas.
controls.halation.halation_amount_help: High-level halation strength multiplier (1.0 = physical defaults). Scales the per-channel halation amplitudes.
controls.halation.halation_spatial_scale: Physical back-reflection size multiplier; scales every channel's first-bounce spread without coupling its strength.
controls.halation.source_compression_hel: Experimental local source-response compression for halation only. Zero preserves the linear response; higher values make secondary bright sources contribute more nearly like the brightest source without changing the base film raw exposure.
controls.halation.protect_ev_help: Protected range above midgray for the boost onset in stops.
controls.halation.boost_range_help: Controls how quickly the highlight boost ramps in, from 0 to 1.
controls.halation.scatter_core_help: Sigma of the scatter core Gaussian per channel [R,G,B], in micrometers. Controls fine-scale sharpness loss in the emulsion.
controls.halation.scatter_tail_help: Decay constant of the scatter exponential tail per channel [R,G,B], in micrometers (internally approximated by a sum of Gaussians). Controls extended low-level spread within the emulsion.
controls.halation.scatter_tail_weight_he: Weight of the scatter tail Gaussian per channel [R,G,B] (0-1). Tail weight + core weight = 1. Higher values put more scattered light into the long tail.
controls.halation.halation_strength_help: Total back-reflection halation amplitude per channel [R,G,B] (0-1). Typical red channel: weak AH 0.02-0.08, no AH 0.08-0.25. The blue channel is usually near zero.
controls.halation.first_sigma_help: Sigma of the first halation bounce per channel [R,G,B], in micrometers. Set by the base thickness (40-80 um for typical cine/still bases).
controls.halation.bounce_count_help: Number of multi-bounce Gaussians summed in the halation pass. Subsequent bounces use sqrt(k)-spaced widths. Typical: 2-3.
controls.halation.bounce_decay_help: Per-bounce amplitude decay ratio (rho). Physical range 0.3-0.7. Controls how fast the halation energy falls off between bounces.
controls.halation.renormalize_help: If enabled, divide by (1 + sum of bounce amplitudes) so mid-grey is preserved. If disabled, halation is purely additive and subtly lifts shadows as well as highlights.
controls.grain.inactive_engine: Inactive until this engine is selected; stored values are retained.
controls.grain.profile_apply_error: Could not apply the grain profile: %{error}
controls.grain.procedural_profile_unavai: available only when the Procedural engine is selected
controls.grain.profile_help: Built-in feature profile; selecting it changes only the declared profile scope.
controls.grain.engine_help: Select the grain engine: Spektra for material grain in developed film density, Procedural for post-scan grain appearance in encoded RGB, Dye for material grain formed in a film-coordinate dye field, Fotufilm Film for effective-appearance film population grain model.
controls.grain.inactive_shared_material: Shared by Spektra and Dye; inactive until either engine is selected, stored values are retained.
controls.grain.named_profile_custom_cont: Custom-only controls are inactive under a named profile; stored overrides are retained. Select Custom to edit them.
controls.grain.fourth_sublayer_remainder: Sublayer 4 is read-only: one minus the first three shares.
controls.grain.rms_granularity_help: Per-channel relative Dye strength: event-area scale k = (G / 6)^2, not a certified optical RMS target. Zero retains the reference-scale fallback; upstream Spektra retains this value as a no-op. Distinct from Procedural Amount.
controls.grain.density_min_help: Minimum grain density shared by Spektra and Dye.
controls.grain.uniformity_help: Per-channel grain uniformity shared by Spektra and Dye.
controls.grain.particle_scale_sublayers_: Positive scale per component: Spektra uses relative particle scales per emulsion sublayer; Dye uses numerical curve components, changing event mass and rate, not separate cloud-kernel widths.
controls.grain.sublayers_active_help: Split the developed density into the film profile's emulsion sublayers instead of applying grain to the composite density. Spektra-only; Dye always uses numerical curve components, and Procedural and Fotufilm ignore it.
controls.grain.particle_area_help: Base statistical particle area in square film micrometers; smaller values give finer grain. Spektra reads this value; Dye uses its own event area.
controls.grain.particle_scale_help: Per-channel multiplier on the particle area; the default makes the blue record coarser. Spektra reads this value; Dye uses the granularity preset instead.
controls.grain.sublayer_count_help: Number of emulsion sub-layers the composite density is split into when sublayers active is off; each sub-layer draws its own grain realization. Spektra-only.
controls.grain.film_resolution_help: Resolution component of the post-scan Procedural appearance algorithm; this does not set scanner lens resolution.
controls.grain.resolution_type_help: Post-scan Procedural appearance resolution method: 0 = Optical Resolution; 1 = Fast Blur. This does not change scanner readout optics.
controls.grain.timer_help: Explicit Grain Procedural phase timer; 0 uses the seed-derived phase.
controls.grain.dye_support_help: Gaussian sigma of the dye support in film micrometers; it conditions the field, which is read in film coordinates.
controls.grain.event_area_help: Base statistical event area in square film micrometers; controls grain strength independently of dye support.
controls.grain.channel_correlation_help: Shared Poisson-event rate fraction among active records within each numerical component, not realized CMY or final RGB correlation. Preserves each record's marginal count distribution; correlation depends on record-rate ratios.
controls.grain.fotufilm_layer_amounts_he: Effective grain amount per emulsion layer.
controls.grain.fotufilm_rms_density_help: Authored effective RMS optical-density target; not measured stock calibration.
controls.grain.fotufilm_cloud_radius_hel: Authored effective population clump radius in film micrometers.
controls.grain.fotufilm_layer_weights_he: Authored effective relative population weight per layer.
controls.grain.fotufilm_layer_size_ratio: Effective relative particle size per layer.
controls.scanner.operator_inactive: Inactive: requires a negative film, an eligible negative-to-positive route and standard conversion style. Stored corrections are retained.
controls.scanner.finished_exposure_help: Finished-positive exposure in stops. Positive values brighten the result after automatic setup, before the fixed tone curve; this does not change camera exposure or film density.
controls.scanner.warmth_help: Red-minus-blue exposure difference in EV. Positive values are warmer; negative values are cooler. This is not Kelvin and does not change capture white balance.
controls.scanner.tint_help: Mean red/blue minus green exposure difference in EV. Positive values add magenta; negative values add green.
controls.scanner.contrast_help: Common exposure contrast around the fixed reference exposure. Above 1 is harder; below 1 is softer. Channel differences and automatic setup are unchanged.
controls.scanner.restore_automatic_help: Reset the four operator values only; keep this frame's own automatic setup.
controls.scanner.copy_correction_help: Copy only the four operator values for this session, not automatic setup, film density or capture settings.
controls.scanner.paste_correction_help: Apply the copied four values to this frame's own automatic setup.
controls.scanner.hold_comparison_help: Hold the primary mouse button or focused Space to view this same frame with default operator values. Release to restore the corrected view. Saved and exported corrections are unchanged.
controls.scanner.input_color_space_help: Color space of the input image, will be internally converted to sRGB and negative values clipped
controls.scanner.input_cctf_decoding_hel: Apply the inverse color component transfer function (CCTF) of the input color space, so the declared encoded samples become linear before the pipeline reads them.
controls.scanner.capture_inactive: Capture illuminant inactive on this route; stored values are retained.
controls.scanner.camera_exposure_help: Add a bias to the auto-exposure of the camera.
controls.scanner.auto_exposure_help: Use the auto-exposure feature of the virtual camera.
controls.scanner.film_format_help: Sets the physical film scale for grain and other film effects. Does not crop, resize, or change the image's aspect ratio. 35mm uses a 36 mm frame long edge; 120 uses a representative 56 mm; 4×5 uses 127 mm.
controls.scanner.metering_method_help: Metering method used by the virtual camera's auto-exposure.
controls.scanner.color_filter_help: Camera taking filter held in front of the lens. Its measured spectral transmittance multiplies the incoming light, so it both darkens and color-casts the exposure (e.g. Hoya Y2/YA3 yellow, R1 red, X0/X1 UV/haze). 'none' = no filter.
controls.scanner.enlarger_inactive: Enlarger inactive on this route; stored values are retained.
controls.scanner.print_exposure_help: Changes the exposure time set in the virtual enlarger
controls.scanner.print_exposure_mode_hel: Auto normalizes the print exposure so the developed midgray density prints to the paper midgray and follows camera exposure compensation, like a color analyzer or minilab. Manual applies the print exposure time alone, like a test strip.
controls.scanner.print_y_shift_help: Y filter shift of the color enlarger from a neutral position, in Kodak CC units
controls.scanner.print_m_shift_help: M filter shift of the color enlarger from a neutral position, in Kodak CC units
controls.scanner.print_illuminant_help: Print illuminant to simulate. Default is the bundled TH-KG3.
controls.scanner.print_tracking_help: How the print exposure follows camera exposure compensation. follow_mode tracks it in auto mode and does not track it in manual; never disables tracking in auto; always applies the relative compensation factor in manual.
controls.scanner.sequence: Scanner sequence: scan output polarity, then readout optics and digital sharpening.
controls.scanner.scanner_inactive: Scanner inactive on this route; stored values are retained.
controls.scanner.scan_output_help: Preserve medium polarity keeps the scanned medium's native scan polarity: a negative film scan reads the negative image on the film, and a photographic-paper or slide scan already reads a positive image. Negative to positive interprets a developed negative as a positive image by inverting the film's own density records and applying the fixed positive tone response.
controls.scanner.conversion_style_help: Named positive-conversion tone of the negative-to-positive interpretation. `standard` measures the whole frame for automatic exposure and color balance before the frozen tone; any other name is a declared style you place in data/scan-styles/, never a fitted surface. The selector lists the styles found there. A style applies only with scan output set to Negative to positive.
controls.scanner.conversion_inactive: Conversion style inactive until Negative to positive is selected; stored values are retained.
controls.scanner.lens_blur_help: Gaussian sigma in pixels on linear transmitted or reflected readout light, before negative conversion, gamut processing, sharpening and encoding. Identity points retain this optical order.
controls.scanner.unsharp_mask_help: Digital scan sharpening after interpretation and output gamut processing: [sigma in pixels, amount].
controls.scanner.white_balance_help: Leave at daylight (D65): it is the colorimetric reference the rest of the pipeline assumes, and should not be changed. Do not use it to neutralize a colour cast — fix white balance downstream with the enlarger filters instead. (custom exposes temperature/tint for special cases.)
controls.scanner.temperature_help: Temperature in Kelvin for the custom whitebalance, not used for the other white balance settings
controls.scanner.raw_tint_help: Tint value for the custom white balance, not used for the other white balance settings
controls.scanner.preflash_inactive: Preflash inactive on this route; stored values are retained.
controls.scanner.preflash_exposure_help: Linear multiplier of the integrated spectral flash, not EV. Zero disables flash and retains its filters. For negative-to-photographic-paper printing, flash can bring weak highlight exposure differences into a responsive part of the paper curve; it cannot recover absent detail. Excess may lower paper white, add fog, alter midtones and change color. Other print materials retain their own polarity.
controls.scanner.preflash_y_shift_help: Independent preflash Yellow shift around the calibrated neutral filter pack, in Kodak CC units.
controls.scanner.preflash_m_shift_help: Independent preflash Magenta shift around the calibrated neutral filter pack, in Kodak CC units.
controls.scanner.capture_illuminant_help: Scene illuminant for the filming front pass; unset inherits the selected film profile reference illuminant (%{reference}). Distinct from film sensitivity calibration, scan and enlarger illuminants, and output white point.
controls.convert.workflow: Workflow: 1) Detect base → 2) Blind calibration (vibrant frame) → 3) Neutralize filters
controls.convert.scan_illuminant_help: Light used to acquire the imported negative RGB. This only changes capture inversion, not the fixed product readout light.
controls.convert.exposure_compensation_h: Aligns the scan's overall brightness to the model (gain = 2^ev). Brighter input -> less recovered film density.
controls.convert.base_percentile_help: Brightest-pixels percentile used by 'Detect base' to sample the clear / unexposed film (99 = brightest 1%). Detect base fits the film Base so that clear film maps to density 0 (unexposed -> neutral).
controls.convert.calibration_help: 3x3 device-correction matrix (9 numbers, row-major) applied to the input before inversion, to undo the scanner/camera colour rendering vs the standard observer over the film dyes (the cross-channel cast that the scan illuminant and base cannot reach). Use 'Blind calibration' to fit it from the current image.
controls.convert.detect_base_help: Sample the brightest clear film and fit film Base plus exposure so unexposed film maps to density zero.
controls.convert.blind_calibration_help: Fit the correction matrix from the current vibrant image; review the fitted values afterwards.
controls.convert.neutralize_filters_help: Solve main enlarger M/Y shifts so the current film base midgray prints neutral. Writes the Enlarger controls.
controls.convert.custom_illuminant_help: Enter any shared catalog illuminant or BB<kelvin> (1667..=25000).
controls.output.simulation_blend_help: Blend the complete result with the decoded, geometrically aligned prepared source in linear output RGB. 1 returns the complete result; 0 returns the prepared source before virtual camera exposure. For a captured negative, zero returns the prepared negative, not a positive interpretation. Input/Output viewing remains independent.
controls.output.output_color_space_help: Color space and transfer encoding of the runtime digital output. It describes what the simulation produces, which is distinct from the saving color space used for the file and from the display transform, which is viewer-only.
controls.output.output_cctf_help: Apply the output color space transfer encoding to runtime output. This is independent of retained Save encoding and display presentation.
controls.output.saving_color_space_help: Color space of the file Save writes. Save writes the retained output in this space without rerendering; Export renders and writes independently with its own saving color space.
controls.output.saving_cctf_help: Add or not the CCTF — %{cctf} — encoding to the samples Save writes. Off writes linear samples. This file-conversion setting is independent of the output color space and of the viewer-only display transform.
controls.crop.upscale_help: Scale image size up to increase resolution
controls.crop.crop_help: Crop image to a fraction of the original size to preview details at full scale
controls.crop.center_help: Center of the crop region in relative coordinates in x, y (0-1)
controls.crop.size_help: Normalized size of the crop region in x, y (0,1), as fraction of the long side.
controls.gamut.input_enable_help: Compress input chromaticities toward the visible spectral locus before spectral upsampling. Off passes input through unchanged.
controls.gamut.input_algorithm_help: xy: radial compression in CIE 1931 chromaticity toward the spectral locus / inscribed hull (ACES RGC family, preserves dominant wavelength). oklch: perceptual chroma reduction in OkLab. off: disable input gamut compression.
controls.gamut.boundary_help: Use the visible spectral locus or its smoothed inscribed hull as the input gamut boundary.
controls.gamut.input_knee_help: Reinhard knee (threshold, limit, power). Default (0.815, 1.0, 1.2) — ACES RGC pair: the 0.815 threshold leaves in-gamut colours untouched, the 1.2 power gives a slow tail so deep-imaginary colours keep their gradation, and limit 1.0 asymptotes on the boundary.
controls.gamut.hull_detail_help: Detail of the inscribed-hull compression boundary = number of FFT modes kept. HIGHER keeps more locus detail (more cusp chroma) but re-admits polygon kinks; LOWER is smoother, rounding the spectral tips inward toward a circle. Note: this is modes-kept, not a blur width — larger means LESS smoothing.
controls.gamut.output_algorithm_help: off: disable output gamut compression. aces_rgc (default): per-channel ACES RGC v1.3, matches Resolve/Nuke/OCIO and is the cheapest per pixel. cam16ucs: CAM16-UCS chroma reduction with the smoothest constant-hue behavior (heaviest). oklch: perceptual chroma reduction in OkLab, preserves hue + lightness. oklrab/jzazbz: alternative perceptual spaces.
controls.gamut.output_knee_help: Reinhard knee (threshold, limit, power) on normalized chroma C/C_max. Default (0.0, 1.0, 6.0) rolls off smoothly from the center with the asymptote on the output cube edge.
controls.upsampling.method_help: Method to upsample the spectral resolution of the image, hanatos2025 works on the full visible locus, mallett2019 works only on sRGB (will clip input).
controls.upsampling.adaptation_window_he: Apply the hanatos2025 bandpass adaptation window when reconstructing spectra.
controls.upsampling.adaptation_surface_h: Apply the hanatos2025 surface adaptation polynomial when reconstructing spectra.
controls.upsampling.gaussian_blur_help: Sigma in nm for Gaussian blur applied to reconstructed spectra.
controls.upsampling.use_cat16_help: Use the CAT16 chromatic adaptation transform for the input RGB to film-space adaptation that feeds the Hanatos spectral upsampling. Off selects CAT02, the pre-0.3.4 behavior.
controls.cmyk.enable_help: Enable the independent CMYK ink style processing stage; retains its strength while disabled.
controls.display.preview_size_help: max size of the long edge of the preview image in pixels
controls.base.enable_film_help: Enable film base-density (film base + fog / orange mask) tuning.
controls.base.film_scale_help: Overall multiplier on the film base density.
controls.base.tilt_help: Spectral tilt of the film base, pivoting at 555 nm (1.0 = +0.1 density at 650 nm; negative tilts the other way).
controls.base.cyan_film_help: Cyan-channel film base density shift around 650 nm (1.0 = neutral; adds (value - 1) density).
controls.base.magenta_film_help: Magenta-channel film base density shift around 555 nm (1.0 = neutral; adds (value - 1) density).
controls.base.yellow_film_help: Yellow-channel film base density shift around 460 nm (1.0 = neutral; adds (value - 1) density).
controls.base.print_scale_help: Overall multiplier on the print base density.
controls.base.cyan_print_help: Cyan-channel multiplicative scale of the print base min around 610 nm (1.0 = neutral).
controls.base.magenta_print_help: Magenta-channel multiplicative scale of the print base min around 530 nm (1.0 = neutral).
controls.base.yellow_print_help: Yellow-channel multiplicative scale of the print base min around 445 nm (1.0 = neutral).
surfaces.state.save_default_help: Replace startup controls with the current state. Adjustment Undo does not reverse this file change.
surfaces.state.restore_factory_help: Replace the current controls and session settings with factory state and remove the saved startup default; confirmation required.
surfaces.state.restore_warning: Replaces the current controls and session settings with the factory state, and removes the saved startup default. Adjustment Undo does not reverse the startup-file change.
surfaces.action.preview_help: Render the bounded preview with the current runtime controls, at the preview max size, and retain it as the viewer's output. Preview disables the spatial and stochastic effects covered by the preview contract, including lens blur, diffusion blur, physical grain, scanner blur, unsharp masking, and glare blur; Procedural and Fotufilm grain, halation, and diffusion filters remain active.
surfaces.action.scan_help: Render the original working resolution with the current runtime controls and retain it as the viewer's output. Spatial and stochastic effects follow their current accepted controls, including any explicit deactivation settings.

photo.queue.title: Export queue
photo.queue.snapshot_help: Each entry exports its submitted source and accepted adjustments, independently of later edits or removal. Retry repeats that exact submission; submit from the work list to export current adjustments.
photo.queue.invalid_destination: Choose a file destination for every export.
photo.queue.duplicate_destination: More than one pending export targets %{path}. Choose distinct destinations before submitting or retrying.
photo.queue.replace_required: The destination %{path} already exists. Explicitly choose replacement before submitting.
photo.error.material_role: The selected film or print material has an incompatible role.
photo.unsaved.title: Save this photograph’s adjustments?
photo.record.accepted_only: Records save accepted adjustments, not an image file. Pending text and RAW decode drafts are excluded.
photo.relocate.title: Locate the recorded source
photo.relocate.help: Choose the same source content at its new location. Source and material dependencies must match the record.
photo.error.source_changed: The source file changed after it was accepted. Reopen it before saving an adjustment record.
photo.queue.dependencies_changed: A material or external model dependency changed after submission. This export was not published. Restore the original dependency to retry this snapshot, or submit current adjustments as a new export.
photo_work.list.title: Work list
photo_work.list.introduction: Selected photographs for this session. Removing an entry never deletes files. Removing unsaved work or closing the application asks you to Save record, Discard, or Cancel for every affected photograph, including inactive copies.
photo_work.list.empty: Add photographs to begin. Single-photograph editing remains available outside this list.
photo_work.list.invalid_entry: The work list entry is no longer available.
photo_work.list.copy_source: Source: the active photograph's accepted adjustments. Check explicit destinations above; the source itself is skipped.
photo_work.list.copy_excluded: Preserved at each destination: source interpretation, accepted RAW decode/settings, geometry, delivery settings, capture calibration (scan illuminant, calibration mode, base percentile), and record-save baseline. Prepared automatic frame setup is not copied. Look uses the existing look resolver; section and feature-profile scopes do not replace materials. Feature-profile scopes replace only their canonical family controls, including custom accepted overrides—not the entire section or its enable/engine switches.
photo_work.list.source_skipped: Skipped: this entry is the copy source.
photo_work.list.copy_done: Adjustments copied. Select this photograph to Undo the copy.
photo_work.list.export_accepted: Submission captures accepted pixels and adjustments independently of later edits or removal. Pending RAW settings and pending control text are excluded.
photo_work.list.no_source: No accepted source image is available.
photo_work.list.no_submissions: No selected photograph could be submitted. Review the entry outcomes.
photo_work.list.export_summary: Accepted Export options: %{format}; %{backend}; %{depth}; %{color}; encoded=%{encoded}. JPEG quality=%{quality}, subsampling=%{subsampling}; TIFF/EXR compression=%{compression} (codec-specific values apply only to their format).
photo_work.list.export_options_guidance: Change format and delivery options in the existing Export dialog; only accepted options shown here are used, not its pending draft.
photo_work.list.replace: Allow replacement of existing output files
photo_work.list.collision_guidance: Output names use each source filename stem and the chosen format extension. Duplicate destinations reject submission: remove one selection or choose a different directory/name before submitting.
photo_work.list.queued: Submitted: immutable export snapshot captured. See queue outcome below.
photo.record.dependencies: Records reference the source, material profiles and runtime assets; keep these external files unchanged. Pending text and RAW drafts, application preferences, history and export jobs are not embedded.
controls.condition.comparison_render: Captured reference has no output or running render
controls.condition.work_remove: Work list entry; removes membership, not files
controls.condition.work_copy: Loaded source; selected destinations; explicit scope
controls.condition.queue_cancel: Pending queue entry; locates the first eligible entry
controls.condition.queue_retry: Failed queue entry; locates the first eligible entry
controls.condition.preset_favorites: Favorites retain built-in or user group identity
photo_work.list.scope_feature_grain: Feature profile: procedural grain (accepted profile and overrides)
photo_work.list.scope_feature_halation: Feature profile: halation (accepted profile and overrides)
